headlines: Treasuries sold off Oct 5-6: 10y near 5.34%, 30y 5.70%, highest since 2002 (older report)
Markets price roughly 25% odds of an October Fed hike (older report, unconfirmed)
Oct 2 close: S&P 500 +0.73%, WTI crude near $91

rumors.text: Pentagon reportedly told CENTCOM to finalize preparations for possible major strikes on Iran, ahead of the midterms
rumors.why: If true, oil would jump and risk assets would sell off; posters also note USO at new highs

rumors.text: Posters say tech alone is holding the index up and that a tech break would drop the market 20-30%
rumors.why: Narrow leadership would make the index fragile, but the size of the drop is crowd exaggeration

readings.whats_new: SPY is 775.9 (-0.17%), a little firmer than the last reading (774.8, -0.55%), with QQQ -0.3% and IWM -0.66%. VIX is unchanged near 15.7 and fear and greed about 45. Stocktwits stays bullish (score 79) but live posts lean bearish on yields and oil, with an unconfirmed Iran strike-prep claim circulating; CMG is up about 6%, SBUX down about 3%, and bitcoin-miner/AI-hosting names (IREN, CIFR, APLD, CLSK) are down 3-8%.
